initial_reasons.MARTY: Enters energized and ready to assess the business situation.
initial_reasons.DION: Waits tensely for Marty to recognize the work he and his father invested.

MARTY.reason: The orange balls immediately validate his expectations and seize his attention.
Hearing that Dion and his father believe in him confirms that his business still has committed support.
Dion directs his attention to the packaging, shifting Marty from the balls to the larger product presentation.
The orange-spheres concept registers as an unexpectedly inspired extension of his identity.
His excitement peaks as the quality and originality of the project overwhelm him.
Calling Dion's drawing inspired turns his astonishment into direct admiration.

DION.reason: Marty's emphatic praise finally gives Dion the recognition he has been seeking.
Marty's claim about Dion's untapped capability lands as deeply affirming, prompting a brief modest withdrawal before returning to Marty.
